title: Worker that stops accepting work on signal and drains in-flight jobs
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag signal handling as unsafe or the 0.2s poll as a busy loop. The handler does the minimum signal-safe work (setting a threading.Event) and all real shutdown happens on the main thread; the timed queue get exists precisely so the stop flag is re-checked even when no work arrives; and leaving the ThreadPoolExecutor context manager waits for every submitted job to finish, so in-flight work drains instead of being killed mid-write.
